vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.iha ghore kalau prāyo jīvaścāsuratāṁ gat: iha ghore kalau prāyo jīvaś-cāsuratāṁ gataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.kva sudhā kva kathā loke kva kācaḥ kva m: kva sudhā kva kathā loke kva kācaḥ kva maṇir-mahān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.abhaktāṁstāṁśca vijñāya na dadau sa kath: abhaktāṁs-tāṁś-ca vijñāya na dadau sa kathāmṛtam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.tadā ṛṣigaṇāḥ sarve vismayaṁ paramaṁ yay: tadā ṛṣi-gaṇāḥ sarve vismayaṁ paramaṁ yayuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.vidhiśrave kutaḥ prītiḥ saṁyogaḥ kutra t: vidhi-śrave kutaḥ prītiḥ saṁyogaḥ kutra taiḥ saha||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.śukena mama yatproktaṁ rahaḥ śiṣyaṁ vicā: śukena mama yat-proktaṁ rahaḥ śiṣyaṁ vicārya ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.ahaṁ tu pṛthivīṁ yāto jñātvā sarvottamām: ahaṁ tu pṛthivīṁ yāto jñātvā sarvottamām-iti|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.na yogī naiva siddho vā na jñānī satkriy: na yogī naiva siddho vā na jñānī sat-kriyo naraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.ekā tu taruṇī tatra niṣaṇṇā khinnamānasā: ekā tu taruṇī tatra niṣaṇṇā khinna-mānasā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.māṁ dṛṣṭvā cotthitā bālā vihvalā cābravī: māṁ dṛṣṭvā cotthitā bālā vihvalā cābravīd-vacaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.bho bhoḥ sādho kṣaṇaṁ tiṣṭha maccintāmap: bho bhoḥ sādho kṣaṇaṁ tiṣṭha mac-cintām-api nāśaya|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.yadā bhāgyaṁ bhavedbhūri bhavato darśana: yadā bhāgyaṁ bhaved-bhūri bhavato darśanaṁ tadā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.kāsi tvaṁ kāvimau cemā nāryaḥ kāḥ padmal: kāsi tvaṁ kāv-imau cemā nāryaḥ kāḥ padma-locanāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.ahaṁ bhaktiriti khyātā imau me tanayau m: ahaṁ bhaktir-iti khyātā imau me tanayau matau|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.tathāpi na ca me śreyaḥ sevitāyāḥ surair: tathāpi na ca me śreyaḥ sevitāyāḥ surair-api||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.vārtā me vitatāpyasti tāṁ śrutvā sukhamā: vārtā me vitatāpy-asti tāṁ śrutvā sukham-āvaha||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.imau tu śayitāvatra sutau me kliśyataḥ ś: imau tu śayitāv-atra sutau me kliśyataḥ śramāt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.sāhaṁ tu taruṇī kasmātsutau vṛddhāvimau: sāhaṁ tu taruṇī kasmāt-sutau vṛddhāv-imau kutaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.vada yoganidhe dhīman kāraṇaṁ cātra kiṁ: vada yoga-nidhe dhīman kāraṇaṁ cātra kiṁ bhavet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.na viṣādastvayā kāryo hariḥ śaṁ te kariṣ: na viṣādas-tvayā kāryo hariḥ śaṁ te kariṣyati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.varṣe varṣe kramājjātā maṅgalaṁ nāpi dṛś: varṣe varṣe kramāj-jātā maṅgalaṁ nāpi dṛśyate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.na tvāmapi sutaiḥ sākaṁ ko'pi paśyati sā: na tvām-api sutaiḥ sākaṁ ko'pi paśyati sāmpratam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.dhanyaṁ vṛndāvanaṁ tena bhaktirnṛtyati y: dhanyaṁ vṛndāvanaṁ tena bhaktir-nṛtyati yatra ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.kathaṁ parīkṣitā rājñā sthāpito hyaśuciḥ: kathaṁ parīkṣitā rājñā sthāpito hy-aśuciḥ kaliḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.pravṛtte tu kalau sarvasāraḥ kutra gato: pravṛtte tu kalau sarva-sāraḥ kutra gato mahān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.imaṁ me saṁśayaṁ chindhi tvadvācā sukhit: imaṁ me saṁśayaṁ chindhi tvad-vācā sukhitāsmy-aham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.yadi pṛṣṭastvayā bāle premataḥ śravaṇaṁ: yadi pṛṣṭas-tvayā bāle premataḥ śravaṇaṁ kuru|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.yadā mukundo bhagavān kṣmāṁ tyaktvā svap: yadā mukundo bhagavān kṣmāṁ tyaktvā sva-padaṁ gataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.na mayā māraṇīyo'yaṁ sāraṅga iva sārabhu: na mayā māraṇīyo'yaṁ sāraṅga iva sāra-bhuk||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.yatphalaṁ nāsti tapasā na yogena samādhi: yat-phalaṁ nāsti tapasā na yogena samādhinā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.viprairbhāgavatī vārtā gehe gehe jane ja: viprair-bhāgavatī vārtā gehe gehe jane jane|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.evaṁ pralayatāṁ prāpto vastusāraḥ sthale: evaṁ pralayatāṁ prāpto vastu-sāraḥ sthale sthale||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.ayaṁ tu yugadharmo hi vartate kasya dūṣa: ayaṁ tu yuga-dharmo hi vartate kasya dūṣaṇam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.iti tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vismayaṁ paramaṁ g: iti tad-vacanaṁ śrutvā vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.bhaktirūce vaco bhūyaḥ śrūyatāṁ tacca śa: bhaktir-ūce vaco bhūyaḥ śrūyatāṁ tacca śaunaka||
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.surarṣe tvaṁ hi dhanyo'si madbhāgyena sa: surarṣe tvaṁ hi dhanyo'si mad-bhāgyena samāgataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0001_mahatmya_padma_dev.iti śrīpadmapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe śrīmadbh: iti śrī-padma-purāṇe uttara-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye bhakti-nārada-samāgamo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 1||

vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.pālitā gopasundaryaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ kvāpi no: pālitā gopa-sundaryaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ kvāpi no gataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.iti niścitya cidrūpaḥ sadrūpāṁ tvāṁ sasa: iti niścitya cid-rūpaḥ sad-rūpāṁ tvāṁ sasarja ha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.tvadājñayā gatā śīghraṁ vaikuṇṭhaṁ punar: tvad-ājñayā gatā śīghraṁ vaikuṇṭhaṁ punar-eva sā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.smṛtā tvayāpi cātraiva muktirāyāti yāti: smṛtā tvayāpi cātraiva muktir-āyāti yāti ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.tasmiṁstvāṁ sthāpayiṣyāmi gehe gehe jane: tasmiṁs-tvāṁ sthāpayiṣyāmi gehe gehe jane jane||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.tadā nāhaṁ harerdāso loke tvāṁ na pravar: tadā nāhaṁ harer-dāso loke tvāṁ na pravartaye||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.na tapobhirna vedaiśca na jñānenāpi karm: na tapobhir-na vedaiś-ca na jñānenāpi karmaṇā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.harirhi sādhyate bhaktyā pramāṇaṁ tatra: harir-hi sādhyate bhaktyā pramāṇaṁ tatra gopikāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.kalau bhaktiḥ kalau bhaktirbhaktyā kṛṣṇa: kalau bhaktiḥ kalau bhaktir-bhaktyā kṛṣṇaḥ puraḥ sthitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.bhaktidrohakarā ye ca te sīdanti jagattr: bhakti-droha-karā ye ca te sīdanti jagat-traye|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.aho nārada dhanyo'si prītiste mayi niśca: aho nārada dhanyo'si prītis-te mayi niścalā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.kṛpālunā tvayā sādho madbādhā dhvaṁsitā: kṛpālunā tvayā sādho mad-bādhā dhvaṁsitā kṣaṇāt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.ṛṣiścintāparo jātaḥ kiṁ vidheyaṁ mayeti: ṛṣiś-cintā-paro jātaḥ kiṁ vidheyaṁ mayeti ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.etadarthaṁ tu satkarma surarṣe tvaṁ samā: etad-arthaṁ tu sat-karma surarṣe tvaṁ samācara|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.nārado vismayaṁ lebhe nedaṁ jñātamiti br: nārado vismayaṁ lebhe nedaṁ jñātam-iti bruvan||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.kiṁ vā tatsādhanaṁ kāryaṁ yena kāryaṁ bh: kiṁ vā tat-sādhanaṁ kāryaṁ yena kāryaṁ bhavet-tayoḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.kva bhaviṣyanti santaste kathaṁ dāsyanti: kva bhaviṣyanti santas-te kathaṁ dāsyanti sādhanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.tatra dvāvapi saṁsthāpya nirgato nārado: tatra dvāv-api saṁsthāpya nirgato nārado muniḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.hariḥ śaraṇamevaṁ hi nityaṁ yeṣāṁ mukhe: hariḥ śaraṇam-evaṁ hi nityaṁ yeṣāṁ mukhe vacaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.bhūmau nipatitau sadyo yatkṛpātaḥ puraṁ: bhūmau nipatitau sadyo yat-kṛpātaḥ puraṁ gatau||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.upāyaḥ sukhasādhyo'tra vartate pūrva eva: upāyaḥ sukha-sādhyo'tra vartate pūrva eva hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.vaikuṇṭhasādhakaḥ panthāḥ sa tu gopyo hi: vaikuṇṭha-sādhakaḥ panthāḥ sa tu gopyo hi vartate|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.satkarma tava nirdiṣṭaṁ vyomavācā tu yat: sat-karma tava nirdiṣṭaṁ vyoma-vācā tu yat-purā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.kalerdoṣā ime sarve siṁhaśabdād vṛkā iva: kaler-doṣā ime sarve siṁha-śabdād vṛkā iva||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.tatkathāsu tu vedārthaḥ śloke śloke pade: tat-kathāsu tu vedārthaḥ śloke śloke pade pade||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.pṛthagbhūtā ca sā miṣṭā tathā bhāgavatī: pṛthag-bhūtā ca sā miṣṭā tathā bhāgavatī kathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.tatra te vismayaḥ kena yataḥ praśnakaro: tatra te vismayaḥ kena yataḥ praśna-karo bhavān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.satsaṅgamaṁ ca labhate puruṣo yadā vai|: sat-saṅgamaṁ ca labhate puruṣo yadā vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/0002_mahatmya_padma_nar.iti śrīpadmapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe śrīmadbh: iti śrī-padma-purāṇe uttara-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye kumāra-nārada-saṁvādo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.kutra kāryo mayā yajñaḥ sthalaṁ tadvācya: kutra kāryo mayā yajñaḥ sthalaṁ tad-vācyatām-iha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.yatra bhāgavatī vārtā tatra bhaktyādikaṁ: yatra bhāgavatī vārtā tatra bhakty-ādikaṁ vrajet|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.yadā yātāstaṭaṁ te tu tadā kolāhalo'pyab: yadā yātās-taṭaṁ te tu tadā kolāhalo'py-abhūt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.bhūrloke devaloke ca brahmaloke tathaiva: bhūr-loke deva-loke ca brahma-loke tathaiva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.dhāvanto'pyāyayuḥ sarve prathamaṁ ye ca: dhāvanto'py-āyayuḥ sarve prathamaṁ ye ca vaiṣṇavāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.kṣetrāṇi ca diśaḥ sarvā daṇḍakādivanāni: kṣetrāṇi ca diśaḥ sarvā daṇḍakādi-vanāni ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.mukhabhāge sthitāste ca tadagre nāradaḥ: mukha-bhāge sthitās-te ca tad-agre nāradaḥ sthitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.sadā sevyā sadā sevyā śrīmadbhāgavatī ka: sadā sevyā sadā sevyā śrīmad-bhāgavatī kathā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.tulasī ca vasantaśca puruṣottama eva ca|: tulasī ca vasantaś-ca puruṣottama eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.ślokārdhaṁ ślokapādaṁ vā paṭhedbhāgavata: ślokārdhaṁ śloka-pādaṁ vā paṭhed-bhāgavataṁ ca yaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.uktaṁ bhāgavataṁ nityaṁ kṛtaṁ ca haricin: uktaṁ bhāgavataṁ nityaṁ kṛtaṁ ca hari-cintanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.dhik taṁ naraṁ paśusamaṁ bhuvi bhārarūpa: dhik taṁ naraṁ paśu-samaṁ bhuvi bhārarūpa-
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.tena yoganidhe dhīman śrotavyā sā prayat: tena yoga-nidhe dhīman śrotavyā sā prayatnataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.śraddhātaḥ śravaṇe nityaṁ māghe tāvaddhi: śraddhātaḥ śravaṇe nityaṁ māghe tāvad-dhi yat-phalam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.yatphalaṁ nāsti tapasā na yogena samādhi: yat-phalaṁ nāsti tapasā na yogena samādhinā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.yadā kṛṣṇo dharāṁ tyaktvā svapadaṁ gantu: yadā kṛṣṇo dharāṁ tyaktvā sva-padaṁ gantum-udyataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.tvaṁ tu yāsyasi govinda bhaktakāryaṁ vid: tvaṁ tu yāsyasi govinda bhakta-kāryaṁ vidhāya ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.maccitte mahatī cintā tāṁ śrutvā sukhamā: mac-citte mahatī cintā tāṁ śrutvā sukham-āvaha||
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.anyo na dṛśyate trātā tvattaḥ kamalaloca: anyo na dṛśyate trātā tvattaḥ kamala-locana||
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.ataḥ satsu dayāṁ kṛtvā bhaktavatsala mā: ataḥ satsu dayāṁ kṛtvā bhakta-vatsala mā vraja|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.tvadviyogena te bhaktāḥ kathaṁ sthāsyant: tvad-viyogena te bhaktāḥ kathaṁ sthāsyanti bhūtale|
vishnu/bhagavata/0003_mahatmya_padma_sor.iti śrīpadmapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe śrīmadbh: iti śrī-padma-purāṇe uttara-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye bhakti-kaṣṭa-nivartanaṁ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.dhanārdhaṁ dharmamārgeṇa tābhyāṁ nītaṁ t: dhanārdhaṁ dharma-mārgeṇa tābhyāṁ nītaṁ tathāpi ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.na putro nāpi vā putrī tataścintāturo bh: na putro nāpi vā putrī tataś-cintāturo bhṛśam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.dṛṣṭvā pītajalaṁ taṁ tu vipro yātastadan: dṛṣṭvā pīta-jalaṁ taṁ tu vipro yātas-tad-antikam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.natvā ca pādayostasya niḥśvasan saṁsthit: natvā ca pādayos-tasya niḥśvasan saṁsthitaḥ puraḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.kiṁ bravīmi ṛṣe duḥkhaṁ pūrvapāpena saṁc: kiṁ bravīmi ṛṣe duḥkhaṁ pūrva-pāpena saṁcitam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.maddattaṁ naiva gṛhṇanti prītyā devā dvi: mad-dattaṁ naiva gṛhṇanti prītyā devā dvijātayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.dhigjīvitaṁ prajāhīnaṁ dhiggṛhaṁ ca praj: dhig-jīvitaṁ prajā-hīnaṁ dhig-gṛhaṁ ca prajāṁ vinā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.yo mayā ropito vṛkṣaḥ so'pi vandhyatvamā: yo mayā ropito vṛkṣaḥ so'pi vandhyatvam-āśrayet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.saptajanmāvadhi tava putro naiva ca naiv: sapta-janmāvadhi tava putro naiva ca naiva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.vivekena bhavetkiṁ me putraṁ dehi balāda: vivekena bhavet-kiṁ me putraṁ dehi balād-api|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.ato haṭhena yukto'si hyarthinaṁ kiṁ vadā: ato haṭhena yukto'si hy-arthinaṁ kiṁ vadāmy-aham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.satyaṁ śaucaṁ dayā dānamekabhaktaṁ tu bh: satyaṁ śaucaṁ dayā dānam-eka-bhaktaṁ tu bhojanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.patnyāḥ pāṇau phalaṁ dattvā svayaṁ yātas: patnyāḥ pāṇau phalaṁ dattvā svayaṁ yātas-tu kutracit||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.taruṇī kuṭilā tasya sakhyagre ca ruroda: taruṇī kuṭilā tasya sakhy-agre ca ruroda ha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.tadagre kathitaṁ sarvaṁ cinteyaṁ mahatī: tad-agre kathitaṁ sarvaṁ cinteyaṁ mahatī hi me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.durbalā tena duḥkhena hyanuje karavāṇi k: durbalā tena duḥkhena hy-anuje karavāṇi kim|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.tāvatkālaṁ sagarbheva guptā tiṣṭha gṛhe: tāvat-kālaṁ sagarbheva guptā tiṣṭha gṛhe sukham|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.vittaṁ tvaṁ matpateryaccha sa te dāsyati: vittaṁ tvaṁ mat-pater-yaccha sa te dāsyati bālakam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.taṁ bālaṁ poṣayiṣyāmi nityamāgatya te gṛ: taṁ bālaṁ poṣayiṣyāmi nityam-āgatya te gṛhe||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.phalamarpaya dhenvai tvaṁ parīkṣārthaṁ t: phalam-arpaya dhenvai tvaṁ parīkṣārthaṁ tu sāmpratam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.tayā ca kathitaṁ bhartre prasūtaḥ sukham: tayā ca kathitaṁ bhartre prasūtaḥ sukham-arbhakaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.tāmākārya gṛhe rakṣa sā te'rbhaṁ poṣayiṣ: tām-ākārya gṛhe rakṣa sā te'rbhaṁ poṣayiṣyati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.trimāse nirgate cātha sā dhenuḥ suṣuve'r: tri-māse nirgate cātha sā dhenuḥ suṣuve'rbhakam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.na jñātaṁ tadrahasyaṁ tu kenāpi vidhiyog: na jñātaṁ tad-rahasyaṁ tu kenāpi vidhi-yogataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.tena veśyākusaṅgena pitryaṁ vittaṁ tu nā: tena veśyā-kusaṅgena pitryaṁ vittaṁ tu nāśitam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.prāṇāṁstyajāmi duḥkhena hā kaṣṭaṁ mama s: prāṇāṁs-tyajāmi duḥkhena hā kaṣṭaṁ mama saṁsthitam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.na cendrasya sukhaṁ kiñcinna sukhaṁ cakr: na cendrasya sukhaṁ kiñcin-na sukhaṁ cakra-vartinaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0004_mahatmya_padma_sto.iti śrīpadmapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe śrīmadbh: iti śrī-padma-purāṇe uttara-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye vipramokṣo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||

vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.taṁ dehaṁ mumucurgarte prāyaḥ sāhasikāḥ: taṁ dehaṁ mumucur-garte prāyaḥ sāhasikāḥ striyaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.na jñātaṁ tadrahasyaṁ tu kenāpīdaṁ tatha: na jñātaṁ tad-rahasyaṁ tu kenāpīdaṁ tathaiva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.strīṇāṁ naiva tu viśvāsaṁ duṣṭānāṁ kāray: strīṇāṁ naiva tu viśvāsaṁ duṣṭānāṁ kārayed-budhaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.hṛdayaṁ kṣuradhārābhaṁ priyaḥ ko nāma yo: hṛdayaṁ kṣura-dhārābhaṁ priyaḥ ko nāma yoṣitām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.saṁhṛtya vittaṁ tā yātāḥ kulaṭā bahubhar: saṁhṛtya vittaṁ tā yātāḥ kulaṭā bahu-bhartṛkāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.na lebhe śaraṇaṁ kvāpi hā daiveti muhurv: na lebhe śaraṇaṁ kvāpi hā daiveti muhur-vadan|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.yasmiṁ stīrthe tu saṁyāti tatra śrāddham: yasmiṁ stīrthe tu saṁyāti tatra śrāddham-avartayat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.evaṁ bhraman sa gokarṇaḥ svapuraṁ samupe: evaṁ bhraman sa gokarṇaḥ sva-puraṁ samupeyivān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.tatra suptaṁ sa vijñāya dhundhukārī svab: tatra suptaṁ sa vijñāya dhundhukārī sva-bāndhavam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.evaṁ pṛṣṭastadā tena rurodoccaiḥ punaḥ p: evaṁ pṛṣṭas-tadā tena rurodoccaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.tvadarthaṁ tu gayāpiṇḍo mayā datto vidhā: tvad-arthaṁ tu gayā-piṇḍo mayā datto vidhānataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.idānīṁ tu nijaṁ sthānamātiṣṭha preta nir: idānīṁ tu nijaṁ sthānam-ātiṣṭha preta nirbhayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.tatsarvaṁ kathitaṁ tena yajjātaṁ ca yath: tat-sarvaṁ kathitaṁ tena yaj-jātaṁ ca yathā niśi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.tataḥ sarvaiḥ sūryavākyaṁ tanmuktau sthā: tataḥ sarvaiḥ sūrya-vākyaṁ tan-muktau sthāpitaṁ param|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.gokarṇaḥ stambhanaṁ cakre sūryavegasya v: gokarṇaḥ stambhanaṁ cakre sūrya-vegasya vai tadā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.tubhyaṁ namo jagatsākṣin brūhi me muktih: tubhyaṁ namo jagat-sākṣin brūhi me mukti-hetukam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.ārdraṁ śuṣkaṁ laghu sthūlaṁ vāṅmanaḥ kar: ārdraṁ śuṣkaṁ laghu sthūlaṁ vāṅ-manaḥ karmabhiḥ kṛtam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.asthireṇa sthiraṁ karma kuto'yaṁ sādhaye: asthireṇa sthiraṁ karma kuto'yaṁ sādhayen-na hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.yatprātaḥ saṁskṛtaṁ cānnaṁ sāyaṁ tacca v: yat-prātaḥ saṁskṛtaṁ cānnaṁ sāyaṁ tacca vinaśyati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.kathātīrthe sthite citte muktireva budha: kathā-tīrthe sthite citte muktir-eva budhaiḥ smṛtā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.śravaṇaṁ tu kṛtaṁ sarvairna tathā manana: śravaṇaṁ tu kṛtaṁ sarvair-na tathā mananaṁ kṛtam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.mananādi tathā tena sthiracitte kṛtaṁ bh: mananādi tathā tena sthira-citte kṛtaṁ bhṛśam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.saṁdigdho hi hato mantro vyagracitto hat: saṁdigdho hi hato mantro vyagra-citto hato japaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.evamādi kṛtaṁ cetsyāttadā vai śravaṇe ph: evam-ādi kṛtaṁ cet-syāt-tadā vai śravaṇe phalam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.śrāvaṇe māsi gokarṇaḥ kathāmūce tathā pu: śrāvaṇe māsi gokarṇaḥ kathām-ūce tathā punaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.saptarātravatīṁ bhūyaḥ śravaṇaṁ taiḥ kṛt: sapta-rātravatīṁ bhūyaḥ śravaṇaṁ taiḥ kṛtaṁ punaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.preṣitā hariloke te yatra gacchanti yogi: preṣitā hari-loke te yatra gacchanti yoginaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.tathā kṛṣṇena te nītā golokaṁ yogidurlab: tathā kṛṣṇena te nītā golokaṁ yogi-durlabham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.taṁ lokaṁ hi gatāste tu śrīmadbhāgavataś: taṁ lokaṁ hi gatās-te tu śrīmad-bhāgavata-śravāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.yogaiśca saṁyānti na tāṁ gatiṁ vai: yogaiś-ca saṁyānti na tāṁ gatiṁ vai
vishnu/bhagavata/0005_mahatmya_padma_dhu.iti śrīpadmapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe śrīmadbh: iti śrī-padma-purāṇe uttara-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye gokarṇa-mokṣa-varṇanaṁ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.teṣu viprā viraktāśca sthāpanīyāḥ prabod: teṣu viprā viraktāś-ca sthāpanīyāḥ prabodhya ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.maṇḍalaṁ ca prakartavyaṁ tatra sthāpyo h: maṇḍalaṁ ca prakartavyaṁ tatra sthāpyo haris-tathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.evaṁ dīnavacaḥ procya vaktāraṁ cātha pūj: evaṁ dīna-vacaḥ procya vaktāraṁ cātha pūjayet|
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.sambhūṣya vastrabhūṣābhiḥ pūjānte taṁ ca: sambhūṣya vastra-bhūṣābhiḥ pūjānte taṁ ca saṁstavet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.saptarātraṁ yathāśaktyā dhāraṇīyaḥ sa ev: sapta-rātraṁ yathāśaktyā dhāraṇīyaḥ sa eva hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.dvidalaṁ madhu tailaṁ ca gariṣṭhānnaṁ ta: dvi-dalaṁ madhu tailaṁ ca gariṣṭhānnaṁ tathaiva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.kāmaṁ krodhaṁ madaṁ mānaṁ matsaraṁ lobha: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ madaṁ mānaṁ matsaraṁ lobham-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.dambhaṁ mohaṁ tathā dveṣaṁ dūrayecca kat: dambhaṁ mohaṁ tathā dveṣaṁ dūrayec-ca kathā-vratī||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.satyaṁ śaucaṁ dayāṁ maunamārjavaṁ vinaya: satyaṁ śaucaṁ dayāṁ maunam-ārjavaṁ vinayaṁ tathā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.apuṣpā kākavandhyā ca vandhyā yā ca mṛtā: apuṣpā kāka-vandhyā ca vandhyā yā ca mṛtārbhakā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.sravadgarbhā ca yā nārī tayā śrāvyā pray: sravad-garbhā ca yā nārī tayā śrāvyā prayatnataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.iti te kathitaṁ sarvaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotum: iti te kathitaṁ sarvaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotum-icchasi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.svarge satye ca kailāse vaikuṇṭhe nāstya: svarge satye ca kailāse vaikuṇṭhe nāsty-ayaṁ rasaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.ataḥ pibantu sadbhāgyā mā mā muñcata kar: ataḥ pibantu sad-bhāgyā mā mā muñcata karhicit||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.surarṣaye kadā brāhmaiśchindhi me saṁśay: surarṣaye kadā brāhmaiś-chindhi me saṁśayaṁ tvimam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.ūcurūrje site pakṣe navamyāṁ brahmaṇaḥ s: ūcur-ūrje site pakṣe navamyāṁ brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.kimarthaṁ vyarthaṁ bho vrajata kupathe k: kim-arthaṁ vyarthaṁ bho vrajata kupathe kutsita-kathe
vishnu/bhagavata/0006_mahatmya_padma_pro.iti śrīpadmapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe śrīmadbh: iti śrī-padma-purāṇe uttara-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye śravaṇa-vidhi-kathanaṁ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||

vishnu/bhagavata/1301_mahatmya_skanda_pa.manāgapi na kāryā te susevyāḥ kintu māta: manāg-api na kāryā te susevyāḥ kintu mātaraḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1301_mahatmya_skanda_pa.kintvekā paramā cintā tatra kiṁcid vicār: kintv-ekā paramā cintā tatra kiṁcid vicāryatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1301_mahatmya_skanda_pa.ātmā tu rādhikā tasya tayaiva ramaṇādasa: ātmā tu rādhikā tasya tayaiva ramaṇād-asau|
vishnu/bhagavata/1301_mahatmya_skanda_pa.atraiva vrajabhūmiḥ sā yatra tattvaṁ sug: atraiva vraja-bhūmiḥ sā yatra tattvaṁ sugopitam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1301_mahatmya_skanda_pa.tasmāccintā na te kāryā vajranābha madāj: tasmāc-cintā na te kāryā vajra-nābha mad-ājñayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1301_mahatmya_skanda_pa.rājye prajāḥ susampannāstvaṁ ca prīto bh: rājye prajāḥ susampannās-tvaṁ ca prīto bhaviṣyasi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1301_mahatmya_skanda_pa.iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryā: iti śrī-skānde mahā-purāṇa ekāśīti-sāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīye vaiṣṇava-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye śāṇḍilyopadiṣṭa-vraja-bhūmi-māhātmya-varṇanaṁ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 1||

vishnu/bhagavata/1302_mahatmya_skanda_co.kiṁ kathaṁ cakratustau tu rājānau sūta t: kiṁ kathaṁ cakratus-tau tu rājānau sūta tad vada||
vishnu/bhagavata/1302_mahatmya_skanda_co.kṛṣṇaikabhaktiṁ sve rājye tatāna ca mumo: kṛṣṇaika-bhaktiṁ sve rājye tatāna ca mumoda ha||
vishnu/bhagavata/1302_mahatmya_skanda_co.vayaṁ virahaduḥkhārtāstvaṁ na kālindi ta: vayaṁ viraha-duḥkhārtās-tvaṁ na kālindi tad vada||
vishnu/bhagavata/1302_mahatmya_skanda_co.sa eva sā sa saivāsti vaṁśī tatpremarūpi: sa eva sā sa saivāsti vaṁśī tat-prema-rūpikā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1302_mahatmya_skanda_co.kintu evaṁ na jānītha tasmād vyākulatāmi: kintu evaṁ na jānītha tasmād vyākulatām-itāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1302_mahatmya_skanda_co.tathā vadasva kālindi tallābho'pi yathā: tathā vadasva kālindi tal-lābho'pi yathā bhavet||
vishnu/bhagavata/1302_mahatmya_skanda_co.iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryā: iti śrī-skānde mahā-purāṇa ekāśīti-sāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīye vaiṣṇava-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye govardhana-parvata-samīpe parīkṣid-ādīnām-uddhava-darśana-varṇanaṁ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.kṛṣṇapatnīṣu vajre ca diṣṭyā prītiḥ prav: kṛṣṇa-patnīṣu vajre ca diṣṭyā prītiḥ pravartitā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.dvārakāstheṣu sarveṣu dhanyā ete na saṁś: dvārakā-stheṣu sarveṣu dhanyā ete na saṁśayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.kṛṣṇacandraḥ sadā pūrṇastasya ṣoḍaśa yāḥ: kṛṣṇa-candraḥ sadā pūrṇas-tasya ṣoḍaśa yāḥ kalāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.ṛte kṛṣṇaprakāśaṁ tu svātmabodho na kasy: ṛte kṛṣṇa-prakāśaṁ tu svātma-bodho na kasyacit|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.dhanaṁ svāsthyaṁ ca śūdrāṇāṁ śrīmadbhāga: dhanaṁ svāsthyaṁ ca śūdrāṇāṁ śrīmad-bhāgavatād bhavet||
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.tvayā sarge niyukto'smi pāpīyān māṁ rajo: tvayā sarge niyukto'smi pāpīyān māṁ rajo-guṇaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.tvatsmṛtau naiva bādheta tathaiva kṛpayā: tvat-smṛtau naiva bādheta tathaiva kṛpayā prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.yadā viṣṇuḥ svayaṁ vaktā lakṣmīśca śrava: yadā viṣṇuḥ svayaṁ vaktā lakṣmīś-ca śravaṇe ratā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.yadā lakṣmīḥ svayaṁ vaktrī viṣṇuśca śrav: yadā lakṣmīḥ svayaṁ vaktrī viṣṇuś-ca śravaṇe rataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.śaktayo mama vidyante devadeva mama prab: śaktayo mama vidyante deva-deva mama prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.ātyantike tu saṁhāre mama śaktirna vidya: ātyantike tu saṁhāre mama śaktir-na vidyate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.sa tu saṁsevanādasya jigye cāpi tamoguṇa: sa tu saṁsevanād-asya jigye cāpi tamo-guṇam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.taṁ yathāmati labdhvā tā āsan virahavarj: taṁ yathāmati labdhvā tā āsan viraha-varjitāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.rājaṁścintā tu te kāpi naiva kāryā katha: rājaṁś-cintā tu te kāpi naiva kāryā kathaṁcana|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.tena prāpsyasi rājaṁstvaṁ nityaṁ dhāma v: tena prāpsyasi rājaṁs-tvaṁ nityaṁ dhāma vrajeśituḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.ityuktastaṁ parikramya gato rājā diśāṁ j: ity-uktas-taṁ parikramya gato rājā diśāṁ jaye||
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.pracakāśe harerlīlā sarvataḥ kṛṣṇa eva c: pracakāśe harer-līlā sarvataḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.ye'nye ca tatra te sarve nityalīlāntaraṁ: ye'nye ca tatra te sarve nitya-līlāntaraṁ gatāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1303_mahatmya_skanda_li.iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryā: iti śrī-skānde mahā-purāṇa ekāśīti-sāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīye vaiṣṇava-khaṇḍe parīkṣid-uddhava-saṁvāde śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.sādhu sūta ciraṁ jīva ciramevaṁ praśādhi: sādhu sūta ciraṁ jīva ciram-evaṁ praśādhi naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.tatsvarūpaṁ pramāṇaṁ ca vidhiṁ ca śravaṇ: tat-svarūpaṁ pramāṇaṁ ca vidhiṁ ca śravaṇe vada|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.samujjṛmbhati yadvākyaṁ viddhi bhāgavata: samujjṛmbhati yad-vākyaṁ viddhi bhāgavataṁ hi tat||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.māyāmardanadakṣaṁ ca viddhi bhāgavataṁ c: māyā-mardana-dakṣaṁ ca viddhi bhāgavataṁ ca tat||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.ta eva santi bho viprā brahmaviṣṇuśivāda: ta eva santi bho viprā brahma-viṣṇu-śivādayaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.haṁsaḥ syāt sāramādatte yaḥ śrotā vividh: haṁsaḥ syāt sāram-ādatte yaḥ śrotā vividhāc-chrutāt|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.śukaḥ suṣṭhu mitaṁ vakti vyāsaṁ śrotṝṁśc: śukaḥ suṣṭhu mitaṁ vakti vyāsaṁ śrotṝṁś-ca harṣayan|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.śrotā snigdho bhavenmīno mīnaḥ kṣīranidh: śrotā snigdho bhaven-mīno mīnaḥ kṣīra-nidhau yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.yastudan rasikāñchrotṝn virautyajño vṛko: yas-tudan rasikāñ-chrotṝn virauty-ajño vṛko hi saḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.svādudrākṣāṁ khaliṁ cāpi nirviśeṣaṁ yath: svādu-drākṣāṁ khaliṁ cāpi nirviśeṣaṁ yathā vṛṣaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.vidhiṁ śṛṇuta bho viprā yena syāt sukhas: vidhiṁ śṛṇuta bho viprā yena syāt sukha-santatiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.teṣāṁ tu karmamārgeṇa yā siddhiḥ sādhunā: teṣāṁ tu karma-mārgeṇa yā siddhiḥ sādhunā kalau||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.dhanaṁ putrāṁstathā dārān vāhanādi yaśo: dhanaṁ putrāṁs-tathā dārān vāhanādi yaśo gṛhān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.yatra bhāgavatī vārtā ye ca tacchravaṇe: yatra bhāgavatī vārtā ye ca tac-chravaṇe ratāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.snāto nityakriyāṁ kṛtvā prāśya pādodakaṁ: snāto nitya-kriyāṁ kṛtvā prāśya pādodakaṁ hareḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.brūyād vā śṛṇuyād vāpi śrīmadbhāgavataṁ: brūyād vā śṛṇuyād vāpi śrīmad-bhāgavataṁ mudā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.gurave vastrabhūṣādi dattvā gāṁ ca samar: gurave vastra-bhūṣādi dattvā gāṁ ca samarpayet|
vishnu/bhagavata/1304_mahatmya_skanda_na.iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryā: iti śrī-skānde mahā-purāṇa ekāśīti-sāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīye vaiṣṇava-khaṇḍe śrīmad-bhāgavata-māhātmye bhāgavata-śrotṛ-vaktṛ-lakṣaṇa-śravaṇa-vidhi-nirūpaṇaṁ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||
